finalText:
**The build works now.** One real error, hiding under all the noise.

`src/core/settings.js` used a bare `retries` that was never declared. Node threw `ReferenceError: retries is not defined`, and the link stage died. I gave it a `DEFAULT_RETRIES = 2` constant and made it read `env.retries` first, which is what the comment there already promised.

Build finishes with 0 errors, exit 0.

The 3 warnings are still there and none of them break anything:

| Code | Where |
| --- | --- |
| W1042 deprecated `crypto.createCipher` | `src/legacy/adapter.js` |
| W2213 unused export `formatLegacyDate` | `src/utils/format.js` |
| W3307 circular import | `src/core/graph.js` ↔ `src/state/tracker.js` |

Say the word and I'll clear those too.
